set.body:
Outcome

Freeze the greenfield public and internal contract before migration edits. ScalaFIM image types become neuroimaging refinements over image4s Sampled and Ravel NDArray, with no legacy source, binary, or ordinal compatibility requirement.

Work

- Define precise core types that retain SampleSpace ownership and ergonomic dynamic-boundary aliases.
- Define Continuous, Categorical, Mask, scalar series, component, and non-spatial-axis contracts.
- Specify constructor ownership, view validity, explicit materialization, equality, metadata, and naming conventions.
- Inventory every NeuroVol, NeuroVec, NeuroSlice, sparse, ROI, cluster, hyper-image, algorithm, I/O, serialization, and downstream consumer affected.
- Record how pending atlas commit 143e6ae7 is to be split or rebuilt rather than merged unchanged.

Acceptance

- A checked-in architecture decision and migration inventory settle every public type, semantic tag, logical order, storage capability, and copy boundary.
- Each constructor and exporter is classified as zero-copy retention, immutable view, explicit copy, or streaming conversion.
- Compile-time probes demonstrate that masks and categorical labels cannot enter continuous interpolation.
- No unresolved compatibility promise or second storage/domain owner remains in the implementation plan.
set.title: Define the native ScalaFIM image contract and breaking API boundary
